_note: Double-balanced mixer with its own oscillator transistor (SA612/NE602 pinout). Engine (bw-board sa612): Gilbert cell, i_a - i_b = I_T tanh(gm v_rf / I_T) tanh(v_lo / 2Vt) with v_rf = in_a - in_b (1.5 kOhm each to an internal bias) and v_lo the oscillator base (osc_b, 18 kOhm to its bias); outputs out_a, out_b 1.5 kOhm to vcc; osc_b/osc_e are an npn (collector at vcc, 4 kOhm emitter load) for a Colpitts or Hartley oscillator. At RF the products land in the bands at f_rf +- f_lo; RF and LO in one band beat at audio (direct conversion, synchronous detection). Params itail (1 mA), gm (8 mS), rin, rout. Reports vRf, vLo, iTail, iOutA, iOutB.
